newsitem.title: UK: Airbus, Lockheed in merger talks.
newsitem.headline: Airbus, Lockheed in merger talks.

text.p: European aircraft consortium Airbus Industrie and U.S. aerospace group Lockheed Martin Corp are holding merger talks in an attempt to combat Boeing's global dominance, Britain's Times newspaper said on Saturday.

The newspaper said a full merger would be impossible before Airbus converts from a multinational consortium to a single company in 1999, but the two companies were examining ways of co-operating ahead of that date.

The Times said the two groups were poised to announce agreements on some major aerospace projects, before attempting a corporate link-up. It said Lockheed was set to become a risk-sharing partner in the development of Airbus' 800-seater superjumbo.
